summary: 22nd Century Group filed an 8-K regarding an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $6.4 million of its common stock under an existing Sales Agreement with Needham & Company. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation. No shares had been sold in the prior 12 months; the company had 4,455,649 shares outstanding. The transaction is routine equity financing with no premium, board recommendation, or structural complexity beyond the ATM mechanics. What to watch: pace of share sales and dilution impact on existing holders.
